title: Zanzibar vs Mauritius: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Zanzibar for culture, value, and East Africa safari pairing. Mauritius for polished luxury resorts and consistent beaches.

categories.name: Beach Quality
categories.summary: Mauritius consistent lagoon. Zanzibar Nungwi is world-class — avoid east coast.

categories.name: Cultural Depth
categories.summary: Stone Town UNESCO, Swahili history, spice tours.

categories.name: Snorkeling & Diving
categories.summary: Mnemba Atoll vs Blue Bay Marine Park — both world-class.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Mauritius one of Africa's safest. Zanzibar safe with precautions.

categories.name: Safari Pairing
categories.summary: 45-min from Dar es Salaam — perfect Tanzania safari add-on.

categories.name: Luxury Resorts
categories.summary: World-class all-inclusives. Zanzibar has boutique options.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Mauritius has direct European flights. Zanzibar requires connections.

faq.question: Is Zanzibar or Mauritius better for a honeymoon?
faq.answer: Reddit ~50/50. Mauritius for stress-free luxury; Zanzibar for adventure + culture.

faq.question: Which is cheaper?
faq.answer: Zanzibar ~2.5x cheaper. Mid-range: Zanzibar $60–120/day vs Mauritius $150–300/day.

faq.question: Which has better beaches?
faq.answer: Mauritius more consistent. Zanzibar Nungwi world-class but requires beach selection knowledge.

faq.question: Best time to visit?
faq.answer: June–October ideal for both. Avoid Zanzibar March–May (heavy rains).
